topic: Enel turns into lightning, but rubber is the one body that can reach him
title: Only Rubber Could Touch the Sky God Enel
description: Enel's whole body becomes lightning, so ordinary attacks pass through him. Here's why rubber was the one thing that could reach him in the Skypiea fight. Full breakdown in the long video.
comment: Does rubber really beat lightning, or was Enel just underestimating Luffy? Pick one side and say why.

lines.text: Enel turns his body into lightning. Luffy walks straight into it.

shot.fallback: pirate walking into a lightning storm

lines.text: Physical attacks pass right through a Logia, and that's the god's whole trick.

shot.fallback: body dissolving into lightning, anime style

lines.text: But Haki still reaches him, which is the first crack in the armor.

shot.fallback: glowing aura striking a lightning figure

lines.text: Here's the detail most people forget: rubber is an insulator.
Lightning hits the rubber, and nothing happens.

shot.fallback: lightning bouncing off a rubber fist

lines.text: So Luffy keeps the god's real body in reach, and the trick stops working.

shot.fallback: pirate closing in on a storm god

lines.text: Enel's plan was never a quiet exit.
He wanted to annihilate the whole sky and leave for Fairy Vearth.
Then he starts raining lightning on the island.

shot.fallback: bolts falling on a sky island

lines.text: So the fight wasn't a side quest. It was the only way to stop the storm.

shot.fallback: pirate facing a storm over clouds

lines.text: The last hit sends him crashing into Shandora's Golden Bell.

shot.fallback: golden bell in ruins with sparks

lines.text: A man made of lightning still has a body, and a rubber fist can find it.

shot.fallback: rubber fist reaching a lightning figure

self_check.hook: Opens with the Logia and lightning claim and a named character in the first line.
self_check.loop: Last line leads back into the Enel body and lightning opening.
